vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning

open and honest; you do not hide information
what people think and say about a person or a company
to say that you are sorry for a problem
a sudden, serious problem that needs action now
a story that people repeat, but nobody knows if it is true
to ask buyers to return a product because it may be unsafe
official words that a company writes or says in public

reading.rtitle: The First Hours of a Crisis
paras: When a crisis starts, most companies make the same mistake: they wait. They want all the facts before they say anything. But in the first hours, a rumor travels faster than the truth, and silence looks like guilt.

Experts give four simple rules. Rule one: choose one spokesperson. If five directors speak to the press, the message changes five times. Rule two: publish a short statement quickly. Say what you know, say what you do not know, and say when you will give more information.

Rule three: be careful with your words. In the first hour, you do not know the cause. It might be a technical problem, or it could be a human error. Never say 'It can't be our fault' too early. If the facts change later, people will remember your words.

Rule four: if the problem is yours, apologize clearly and explain what you are doing to fix it. If a product is unsafe, recall it. Being transparent can cost money for a month. Hiding the truth can cost a reputation for years.

gapfill.text: In a crisis, modals help you speak carefully: 'It MIGHT BE the container' (maybe), 'It MUST BE the cooling unit' (almost sure), 'It CAN'T BE the fruit' (sure it is not). You give information without promising more than you know.

bank.label: Useful sentences for the first hours of a crisis
items: We do not know the cause yet.
It might be a problem with the container.
It must be the cooling unit.
It can't be the fruit. It passed every test.
We will publish a short statement today.
I am the spokesperson for this case.
If it is our mistake, we will apologize.

items.situation: A journalist calls. You do not know the cause yet. Answer carefully.
tips: We do not know the cause yet,
but it might be a problem in transport.

items.situation: The log shows that the cooling unit stopped. Say what you are almost sure of.
Your farms passed every test last month. Say what is not possible.
The problem is yours. Say what you will do.

listenings.text: Hi Rafael, it is Daniel Visser from Harbor Fresh in Rotterdam. I want to give you the facts before you speak to anyone. We opened container forty-two this morning. About a third of the boxes are damaged, and the fruit is soft. Our technician says the cooling unit stopped for six hours during the trip, so it must be a problem with the container, not with your farms. It might be the shipping company's fault, but we are not sure yet. A journalist called me an hour ago. I told her that we were checking the facts. Please call me before you publish your statement.

I am a journalist, and I write about the food industry. When there is a problem, I call the company. Some companies answer in ten minutes. The spokesperson tells me what they know and promises to call me back with more facts. Those stories are usually short and fair. Other companies say nothing. Then I have to write that the company did not comment, and readers think the worst. My advice is simple: answer the phone. If you do not know the cause, say that it might be one thing or another, and say when you will know more. A rumor needs silence to grow.

extra_audio.text: Check the facts with the team in Rotterdam. Choose one spokesperson for the company. Publish a short statement on the same day. Answer the questions from the press. Give an update the next morning.
